notes.title: TREE's soundtrack is now on Spotify
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Another quick word from us. 

Our game's soundtrack is now available for free on Spotify. So, if you want to listen to our music on the go, in the office, while you're doing work, or just relaxing, you can now do so in the link below. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152816/cd5270ecf9eca52e1ddfd9c29042b58bb239c423.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6OTir3xKtJOti7nQ8OgSqH?si=xLF9yfoBQlmN-92VNyymhw] TREE by Pawel Blaszczak [/url][/h1]

Once again, thank you for all your support. And please, leave a comment/feedback/anything at all - we love reading your thoughts. 

It's been a beautiful story so far - thanks for being a part of it. 


Until (maybe) next time, 

Taj
